name: Devouring Plague
summary: Forsaken priests in the Undercity learn Devouring Plague from Priestess Aelthalyste. The rite is for those who have proven their dedication to shadow magic, and teaches a feared curse of the undead priesthood.

sections.title: A Curse of the Shadow
sections.body: In the Undercity’s War Quarter, Priestess Aelthalyste teaches Forsaken priests the grim arts of the Shadow. Priests of other races draw power from the Holy Light or ancestral spirits, but the Forsaken have shaped their own spiritual doctrines. Devouring Plague gives form to that path: it torments foes and drains their stolen vitality to sustain the caster’s decaying body.

sections.title: A Test of Mastery
sections.body: Priestess Aelthalyste shares the plague’s power only with care. The spell is a weapon of potent malice, meant to turn the tide against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. As she teaches it, she warns her disciples to practice until their command is sure. Greater trials await those who seek mastery of the dark arts.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what does devouring plague quest do
faq.answer: This rite teaches Forsaken priests who have reached seasoned standing to cast Devouring Plague. The shadow affliction drains its victim and heals the caster.

Priestess Aelthalyste is a Forsaken priest trainer in the Undercity’s War Quarter. She guides emerging shadow casters and sees that they wield their destructive blessings effectively for the Forsaken.

faq.q: Can priests of other races learn Devouring Plague from Aelthalyste?
faq.answer: Devouring Plague isn't hers alone to give: every priest, whatever their race, learns it from a priest trainer at level 20. The Forsaken's own racial teachings are Touch of Weakness and Dark Sacrifice.

faq.q: Where do I turn in this quest?
faq.answer: Priestess Aelthalyste is in the War Quarter of the Undercity, among the Forsaken priest instructors and practitioners.

faq.q: Why do Forsaken priests specialize in plague and shadow magic?
faq.answer: Forsaken priests feel intense physical pain when they channel the Holy Light because they are undead. Many turn to the Shadow, using afflictions, curses, and stolen life-force to survive and wage war.

faq.q: What tests is Aelthalyste referring to?
faq.answer: As a priest grows in power, Aelthalyste warns, trials across Lordaeron grow harder. Dark magic draws dangerous scrutiny and deadly foes, so an acolyte must command every curse in their repertoire.

angles.text: As a Forsaken priest, you learn one of your most dreaded spells, tying your survival to the affliction you inflict on your enemies.
As an Undead, you inherit a path of plague-like shadowcraft that reflects the Forsaken’s departure from traditional Lordaeron worship after the Third War.
As a member of the Horde, you bring ruthless, disease-like curses to its arsenal, while other allies rely on ancestral spirits or elemental balance.
